questions.question: Which recall campaigns of the 2015 Ford Escape concern its automatic transmission? (domain graph only)
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Recall)-[:AFFECTS_VEHICLE]->(:Vehicle {model: 'ESCAPE'}) WHERE r.Component CONTAINS 'AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION' RETURN DISTINCT r.NHTSACampaignNumber

questions.question: Which vehicles do owners report braking on its own or suddenly?
questions.cypher: MATCH (v:Vehicle)-[:HAS_OBSERVATION]->(o:Observation)-[:SUBJECT|OBJECT]->(p:Mention {type: 'Problem'}) WHERE any(n IN [p.name] + coalesce(p.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'brak') AND any(n IN [p.name] + coalesce(p.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'sudden' OR toLower(n) CONTAINS 'its own' OR toLower(n) CONTAINS 'activat') RETURN DISTINCT v.model

questions.question: Which vehicles do owners report with a cracked windshield?
questions.cypher: MATCH (v:Vehicle)-[:HAS_OBSERVATION]->(o:Observation)-[:SUBJECT|OBJECT]->(p:Mention {type: 'Problem'}) WHERE any(n IN [p.name] + coalesce(p.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'crack') AND (any(n IN [p.name] + coalesce(p.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'windshield') OR EXISTS { MATCH (o)-[:SUBJECT|OBJECT]->(w:Mention) WHERE w <> p AND any(n IN [w.name] + coalesce(w.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'windshield') }) RETURN DISTINCT v.model

questions.question: Which vehicles do owners report with air bags that failed to deploy?
questions.cypher: MATCH (v:Vehicle)-[:HAS_OBSERVATION]->(o:Observation)-[:SUBJECT|OBJECT]->(p:Mention {type: 'Problem'}) WHERE any(n IN [p.name] + coalesce(p.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'deploy') RETURN DISTINCT v.model

questions.question: Which engine recall campaign belongs to the vehicle whose owners report a piston ring recall?
questions.cypher: MATCH (v:Vehicle)-[:HAS_OBSERVATION]->(:Observation)-[:SUBJECT|OBJECT]->(e:Mention) WHERE e.type IN ['Recall', 'Component'] AND any(n IN [e.name] + coalesce(e.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'piston') MATCH (v)<-[:AFFECTS_VEHICLE]-(r:Recall) WHERE r.Component STARTS WITH 'ENGINE' RETURN DISTINCT r.NHTSACampaignNumber

questions.question: Which vehicles do owners report with a transmission that switched to reverse on its own? (a part kind shared by several vehicles)
questions.cypher: MATCH (v:Vehicle)-[:HAS_OBSERVATION]->(o:Observation)-[:SUBJECT|OBJECT]->(p:Mention {type: 'Problem'}) WHERE any(n IN [p.name] + coalesce(p.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'reverse') AND any(n IN [p.name] + coalesce(p.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'switch') RETURN DISTINCT v.model

questions.question: Which engine recall campaign affects the vehicle of complaint 10823637, whose own record carries a piston claim? (R67: starts at the Complaint record's HAS_OBSERVATION, no Document-ABOUT jump)
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Complaint {odiNumber: 10823637})-[:HAS_OBSERVATION]->(:Observation)-[:SUBJECT|OBJECT]->(e:Mention) WHERE any(n IN [e.name] + coalesce(e.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'piston') MATCH (c)-[:CONCERNS_VEHICLE]->(:Vehicle)<-[:AFFECTS_VEHICLE]-(r:Recall) WHERE r.Component STARTS WITH 'ENGINE' RETURN DISTINCT r.NHTSACampaignNumber
